name: laminin subunit gamma 1

function.text: LAMC1 is the approved symbol for laminin subunit gamma 1. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in extracellular matrix structural constituent; cell adhesion; cell migration.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Glioblastoma; Low-grade glioma; Lung squamous cell carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: LAMC1 encodes laminin subunit gamma 1. Its functions include extracellular matrix structural constituent and cell adhesion.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LAMC1 have been reported in glioblastoma, low-grade glioma, and thyroid carcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
